date_basis: US episode date. NBC/Peacock identifies season 46 episode 18 as Elon Musk: May 8, 2021. Reuters gives the start as 11:30 p.m. EDT Saturday, equivalent to 03:30 UTC on May 9.

primary_sources.publisher: Saturday Night Live, verified official YouTube channel
primary_sources.title: Weekend Update: Financial Expert Lloyd Ostertag on Cryptocurrency - SNL
primary_sources.supports: Musk's fictional financial-expert character and the Weekend Update segment's Dogecoin subject
primary_sources.retrieval: Official search-index title, channel and description verified. Direct web opening returned an internal error; full video playback was not performed. Dialogue is separately corroborated by contemporaneous Reuters reporting.

primary_sources.supports: May 8, 2021 episode date; season 46 episode 18; host Elon Musk and musical guest Miley Cyrus
primary_sources.retrieval: Official episode page opened and read

contemporaneous_reporting.supports: Pre-show anticipation; Musk's public Dogecoin interest; broadcast start time; Che/Musk comedy exchange; Binance low of $0.416, approximately 36% below about $0.65 before the programme, with a subsequent partial rebound
contemporaneous_reporting.retrieval: Full article opened and relevant passages read
contemporaneous_reporting.qualification: Exchange- and reporting-window-specific historical figures. No inference that one line solely caused all market moves, and no investment outcome guaranteed.

interpretation: The suited anthropomorphic Doge, backstage viewpoint, light, desk rendering, camera arrangement and curtain are fictional symbolic artwork. The book does not assert that an actual dog appeared on the SNL set or that the scene documents NBC's floor plan.
